mechanics.claim: Pix's bolts do not fire alongside on-hit effect abilities like Runaan's Hurricane.
mechanics.quote: ''Pix's'' bolts do not fire alongside abilities that apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects (e.g. {{ii|Runaan's Hurricane}}).

mechanics.claim: Pix does not fire if the target dies (e.g. before the attack lands).
mechanics.quote: ''Pix'' does not fire if the target dies.

mechanics.claim: Casting Help, Pix! on an ally transfers Pix so their basic attacks trigger the bolts instead of Lulu's.
mechanics.quote: Casting ''{{ai|Help, Pix!|Lulu}}'' on an ally champion transfers ''Pix's'' help to them, causing him to fire the bolts dependent on their basic attacks.

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack does not trigger against structures or wards.
mechanics.quote: The empowered attack does not trigger against {{tip|structures}} nor {{tip|wards}}.
